label: Likelihood of an all-on supplier panel counts each distinct live ray once
paraphrase: Observe the activity of specified positions on parallel supplier chains. Assign one local coordinate to each distinct observed ray with an intact tail, and one shared coordinate to all rays. Under a finite discrete product model, every sampled report extends to a full local transmission state. An upstream cut at any requested position gives the all-positive event probability zero. For an all-live panel with n distinct rays its probability is one at n=0 and κ(G) times ν(C)^n otherwise. Taking ν(C)=1 gives a single shared random setting in the observation model. Taking κ(G)=1 gives independent local settings. A sampling plan fixed before consulting outcomes and a calibrated dependence model are needed to use these likelihoods as evidence.
